notes.title: New Gameplay
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce our latest update, packed with new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience!

🔄 [b]New "Undo" Button[/b]
Introducing the "Undo" button! This new feature allows you to cancel your last letter choice, whether to correct a mistake or strategically reroll a single letter. It’s a game-changer for refining your strategy and achieving longer word chains.

🎨[b] Improved Interface[/b]
We’ve adjusted the screen size in the menus to ensure a cleaner, more user-friendly interface across a variety of screens. Navigate with ease and enjoy a smoother gameplay experience.

🌐 [b]New Translations: Spanish and French[/b]
We’ve added translations for the game’s interface in Spanish and French. Switch languages easily in the settings and enjoy the game in your preferred language!

🔜 [b]Coming Soon: Steam Achievements[/b]
Stay tuned for our next update, which will bring Steam achievements to the game. Get ready to unlock new accomplishments and showcase your skills!

[b]Thank You for Your Support![/b]
We greatly appreciate your feedback and continued support. Your input helps us improve and grow our community.

Thank you for playing, and see you in the next update!

The Development Team 🚀
